mapper.select: SELECT cp.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_customer_price cp JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = cp.material_id WHERE cp.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY m.code
